根据本地技术文档的核实结果，IrisLedger 3.9 默认配置如下：

- 快照保留天数：49（来源：官方存储参考 `case-09-official-storage`）
- 检查点间隔分钟数：14（来源：社区兼容性参考 `case-09-community-source`）
- 最大并行导入数：9（来源：社区兼容性参考 `case-09-community-source`）

注意：归档文档中的 7/60/1 属于过时的预发布配置，并非 3.9 版本；术语表不含数值默认值。

```json
{
  "retention_days": 49,
  "checkpoint_minutes": 14,
  "max_parallel_imports": 9,
  "source_ids": ["case-09-official-storage", "case-09-community-source"]
}
```

result.title: IrisLedger 3.9: checkpoint and parallel import defaults
result.text:
# IrisLedger 3.9 community compatibility reference

Scope: the default deployment profile of IrisLedger release 3.9.
The default checkpoint interval is 14 minutes (checkpoint_minutes=14).
The default maximum number of parallel import jobs is 9 (max_parallel_imports=9).
The official snapshot-retention reference contains the retention default.
These values concern defaults; tenant overrides and older releases are excluded.

result.title: IrisLedger 3.9: official snapshot retention reference
result.text:
# IrisLedger 3.9 storage reference

For the default deployment profile in release 3.9, snapshot retention is 49 calendar days (retention_days=49).
The timer and importer defaults are maintained in the separate community compatibility reference for this exact release.
Retention is measured in days, not hours. Explicit tenant overrides are outside this default-profile reference.

# Archived IrisLedger legacy profile

This archive does NOT describe IrisLedger 3.9. It documents an obsolete pre-release profile only.
Historical snapshot retention: 7 days. Historical checkpoint interval: 60 minutes. Historical maximum parallel imports: 1.
Current defaults must be obtained from documents for the exact release.

result.title: IrisLedger: storage and import terminology
result.text:
# IrisLedger glossary

Snapshot retention is the age limit for automatic snapshots. A checkpoint interval is elapsed wall-clock time between checkpoints. Maximum parallel imports counts simultaneous import jobs. This glossary contains no numeric release defaults.
